agent.name: Emerging Technology Landscape Agent
agent.specialty: Dated competitive landscape and reassessment triggers

general_et_finding: 2026-11-16 | Standardized identifier syntax; deployment is workflow-specific. A phone can open a web link, while a checkout must interpret the identifier. GS1’s 2027 ambition does not measure installed compatibility. No independent market-share or unit-cost measurements in the register.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the distinction between syntax and deployment; low confidence in incremental value or partner readiness without local measurements.
analytical_question: Should we fund a two-style comparison this quarter?
application_finding: Experiment. Compare two tags that both open the same approved care content: a plain brand URL QR and a GS1 identifier QR. Either could work; standardization earns its extra mapping effort only if shared identifiers reduce variant errors or upkeep.
organization_specific_finding: The brand controls its website and can replace two hangtags. Its existing sewn-in label remains the fallback. A small comparison is feasible within 90 days; a catalog conversion is premature.

evidence.claim: Defines how a product identifier can appear in a web address. Extracting identifiers requires software that understands the syntax.
evidence.source_or_reference: S1 GS1 | Digital Link URI syntax 1.7.0 https://ref.gs1.org/standards/digital-link/uri-syntax/1.7.0/
evidence.notes: Proves a specification exists; no installed-base or cost estimate.

evidence.claim: Documents opening a QR link through Camera or Code Scanner.
evidence.source_or_reference: S3 Apple | Scan a QR code with your iPhone or iPad https://support.apple.com/en-us/102680
evidence.notes: No evidence about Android devices, garment print durability, or customer demand.

evidence.claim: End-2027 is a capability ambition. A transition may require software or scanner upgrades.
evidence.source_or_reference: S2 GS1 | 2D Barcodes at Retail POS, release 1.1, §1.2 https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/2d-in-retail/1.1.0/GS1-2DRetailPOS-Guideline-i1.1-r-2025-12-15
evidence.notes: Same issuer as S1; does not independently corroborate adoption.

evidence.claim: Qualitative questionnaire: 63 students at two universities discussed apparel labels and QR codes.
evidence.source_or_reference: Ghalachyan & Loranger | Gen Z attitudes to digital apparel labels https://doi.org/10.1080/17543266.2026.2629836
evidence.notes: Attitudes, not observed care decisions. Neither encoding method nor this brand was tested.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Ordinary brand URLs can also redirect. Scan volume cannot distinguish useful care guidance from curiosity.
No measured care accuracy, demand, labor saving or cost advantage.
A removable hangtag may be gone at first wash. Even a perfect scan-to-page rate excludes the people who no longer have the tag.
value_opportunity_implication: Compare 90-day net benefit with plain URL: (minutes saved per catalog edit / 60 × loaded hourly rate × expected edits) minus incremental setup, print and hosting costs. Get both quotes and time the same catalog correction; no observed inputs yet. If savings cannot cover costs, keep plain URLs.
risk_governance_implication: Product content owner approves every care page; withdraw a tag on any wrong variant. Keep printed care instructions.
recommendation_management_implication: After removing the hangtag, ask shoppers how they would dry the exact garment. Count correct answers against the approved variant sheet over ALL attempts, including missing tags and abandoned lookups. Keep sewn-in care visible. Compare label alone, plain URL QR and GS1 QR on matched variants with identical content for the two QR arms; counterbalance order. Record at-purchase and later tasks separately.
change_monitoring_triggers: Content owner checks every variant before printing and weekly for four weeks. Any incorrect destination: withdraw affected tag and repair mapping.

Day 30: product operations reviews at least 20 attempts per arm, separately by use moment. Zero wrong destinations; only extend if correct task completion is no worse than the best incumbent and 90-day incremental benefit is positive. Inconclusive: retain incumbent and report uncertainty.
Standards lead checks revision and compatibility quarterly and before each reprint. Re-run routing tests if URI rules or domain configuration changes.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: No ROI or scale recommendation until comparable workload and cost data exist. Thresholds are proposed decision rules, not industry benchmarks.
